claims.text: The oldest surviving copy of the text was found in China in 1972, in bamboo slips from a Han tomb.
The famous English edition of 1961 was translated from a Japanese edition, not from Chinese.
Qi Jiguang's own manuals, not Sun Tzu, are what reformed Chinese warfare in the sixteenth century.

timeline.what: the English edition that made the book famous
